quotationRule: Every rightsStatement and approvalStatement below is copied byte-for-byte from the named cell of the register whose digest is recorded here. scripts/build-media-derivatives.mjs re-reads the register and refuses any row whose cell has moved, so an edit to the register invalidates the corresponding ledger row instead of quietly authorising a derivative from stale evidence.
